description: This file defines a Flutter widget named BillDetailsCard, which displays billing details including item price, discounts, delivery charges, taxes, and total charges. It also provides UI elements for applying a coupon and initiating a checkout process, with a placeholder for Razorpay integration.

classes.name: BillDetailsCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders billing details, coupon application UI, and a checkout button.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BillDetailsCard, displaying billing info and buttons.
